description: Generate a booking URL for selected car rental option. Creates a reservation link that can be used to complete the car rental booking process. When the car service rejects the selection (the car is no longer available or the ids don't belong to the search), success is false with error_code reservation_rejected and no link: run car_search again. A warning means the link was built without the service's check. Use after car_search, once the user has chosen a car. Returns a link where the user completes booking and payment on the site; nothing is booked or charged by this tool.

request_id.description: Top-level request_id from car_search or selected reservation allocation.arguments.request_id (starts with 'cr'). Do not use reservation.requestId.

reservation_id.description: Selected car reservation referenceId or allocation.arguments.reservation_id from search results (starts with 'ref').

trip_type.description: Type of travel: 'domestic' for within country or 'international' for cross-border from previous car search

name: car_allocate
title: Get car rental booking link
